sentence: This project studies how slow stroking and deep pressure, parts of massage therapy, affect touch pleasantness and pain.
This project upgrades the software used by a study that follows youth who engaged in hazardous drinking, to keep its data secure.
This project studies how actin methylation controls the integrity and repair of the gut barrier.
This project sequences whole genomes of bulk and single cells from clinical samples to look for genomic changes in myeloma at diagnosis and relapse.
This project builds a model to test which ways of preventing cardiovascular disease work best for survivors of breast, prostate and lung cancer.
This project develops molecular imaging, nanoparticles and theranostics to improve outcomes for cancer patients.
This project builds a clinical decision support tool that predicts cardiopulmonary deterioration in hospitalized children.
This project tries to find out which pneumonia patients benefit from steroids, when to give them, and how much to give.
This project studies how time-dependent nonlinearities shape retinal responses to natural stimuli and builds models that predict those responses.
This project tries to find genetic conditions and how common they are among Amish and Mennonites.
This project supports cancer researchers with study design, statistical analysis, bioinformatics and data management.
This project tests whether Cas9 nickase, aimed at amplified genes, can kill neuroblastoma cells by damaging their DNA.
This project uses gene editing to redirect B cells toward tumor antigens and tests this in breast cancer mouse models.
This project develops a method using native mass spectrometry to identify which lipids bind to membrane proteins.
This project focuses on virology research on infectious diseases.
This project works to improve survival and quality of life for children with solid tumors by combining basic, clinical and survivorship research.
This project tests a therapy that combines inhibitors with macrophages engineered with chimeric antigen receptors to treat pancreatic cancer.
This project uses human induced pluripotent stem cells, micropatterned culture, biomaterial scaffolds and microfluidics to study how tissues assemble and mature.
This project provides high-resolution imaging of the mitochondria and analyses of cell metabolism for its research projects.
